requirements.statement: As a Customer, I want to register my customer details, so that my orders can be delivered to me and I can be contacted about them.

acceptance_criteria.text: Each customer record holds a name, an address and a phone number, each of which is mandatory.
A customer has zero or one bank account, and the bank account is the only optional attribute of a customer.
Given a customer registration in which the name, the address or the phone number is absent, When the customer submits it, Then the system rejects the registration and stores no customer record.
Given a customer registration that holds a name, an address and a phone number but no bank account, When the customer submits it, Then the system stores the customer record without a bank account.
Given a customer registration that holds a name, an address, a phone number and one bank account, When the customer submits it, Then the system stores the customer record with that bank account.
Given a customer registration that names more than one bank account, When the customer submits it, Then the system rejects the registration and stores no customer record.

requirements.statement: As a Customer, I want to browse the products on offer, so that I can choose which products to order.

acceptance_criteria.text: Each product record holds a name, a description, a price and an image, each of which is mandatory.
The price of a product is a decimal number.

Given a product record in which the name, the description, the price or the image is absent, When it is submitted for storage, Then the system rejects it and the product does not appear among the products on offer.
Given stored products, When the customer browses the products on offer, Then the system shows the name, the description, the price and the image of each product.
A product may be referred to by any number of order items, including none.
Given a product that is referred to by the order items of an order, When that order and its order items are removed, Then the product still exists and remains among the products on offer.

requirements.statement: As a Customer, I want to submit an order for one or more products, so that I receive the products I have chosen.

acceptance_criteria.text: Given a known customer, one or more order items that each refer to an existing product, and a payment method, When the customer submits the order, Then the system registers an order associated with that customer, with the submission date as its order date and the status submitted.
Given an order submission that names a customer not known to the system, When the customer submits it, Then the system rejects the submission and registers no order.
Given an order submission that contains no order item, When the customer submits it, Then the system rejects the submission and registers no order.
Given an order submission in which at least one order item refers to a product that does not exist, When the customer submits it, Then the system rejects the submission and registers no order.
Given an order submission whose payment method is not bank, card or cash, When the customer submits it, Then the system rejects the submission and registers no order.
The total amount of a registered order equals the sum over its order items of quantity multiplied by unit price.
Each order holds an order date, a total amount, a status and a payment method, each of which is mandatory.
Each order item holds a quantity, a unit price and a reference to exactly one product, each of which is mandatory.
Each order item belongs to exactly one order and cannot be moved to another order.
An order item exists only as part of the order it belongs to, and the order items of an order are removed when that order is removed.
Each order is associated with exactly one customer, and a customer may have any number of orders.
The total amount of an order and the unit price of an order item are decimal numbers.
The payment method of an order is one of bank, card or cash.
The status of an order is one of submitted, pending, filled, shipped or closed.

requirements.statement: As an Accountant, I want to raise an invoice for a filled order, so that the customer is billed for the goods supplied.

acceptance_criteria.text: Given an order whose status is filled or shipped and that has no invoice, When the accountant raises an invoice for it with a date, an amount and a payment method, Then the system records the invoice for that order with the status issued.
Given an order that already has an invoice, When the accountant raises a further invoice for it, Then the system rejects the request and records no further invoice.
Given an order whose status is submitted, pending or closed, When the accountant raises an invoice for it, Then the system rejects the request and records no invoice.
Given an order that has been declined, When the accountant raises an invoice for it, Then the system rejects the request and records no invoice.
Given a filled order that has not been shipped, When the accountant raises an invoice for it, Then the system records the invoice without requiring the order to have been shipped.
Raising the invoice of a filled order and setting that order to shipped may occur in either order or at the same time.
Each invoice holds a date, an amount, a status and a payment method, each of which is mandatory.
Each invoice is associated with exactly one order, and an order has at most one invoice.
The amount of an invoice is a decimal number.
The payment method of an invoice is one of bank, card or cash.
The status of an invoice is one of issued or paid.
The status of an invoice changes only from issued to paid.

requirements.statement: As a Customer, I want to pay an issued invoice, so that I settle what I owe for my order.

acceptance_criteria.text: Given an invoice whose status is issued, When the customer submits a payment against it with a date, an amount and a payment method, Then the system records the payment against that invoice with the status pending.
Given an invoice whose status is paid, When the customer submits a payment against it, Then the system rejects the payment and records no payment.

Given an invoice whose earlier payment has the status failed, When the customer submits a further payment against it, Then the system records the further payment as a separate payment with the status pending and keeps the earlier payment at the status failed.
Each payment is recorded against exactly one invoice and never directly against an order, and an invoice may have any number of payments.
Each payment holds a date, an amount, a status and a payment method, each of which is mandatory.
The amount of a payment is a decimal number.
The payment method of a payment is one of bank, card or cash.
The status of a payment is one of pending, completed or failed.
The status of a payment changes only from pending to completed or from pending to failed.

requirements.statement: As an OrderStaff, I want to receive a submitted order, so that I can take it in hand for validation and fulfilment.

acceptance_criteria.text: Given an order whose status is submitted, When the order staff receives it, Then the system sets the status of the order to pending.
Given an order whose status is not submitted, When the order staff attempts to receive it, Then the system rejects the attempt and leaves the status of the order unchanged.
Given an order whose status is closed, When the order staff attempts to receive it, Then the system leaves the status of the order at closed.
Receiving an order changes its status only from submitted to pending.
The status of an order is one of submitted, pending, filled, shipped or closed.

requirements.statement: As an OrderStaff, I want to mark a pending order as filled, so that everyone knows the goods are ready for shipping and invoicing.

acceptance_criteria.text: Given an order whose status is pending, When the order staff marks it as filled, Then the system sets the status of the order to filled.
Given an order whose status is not pending, When the order staff attempts to mark it as filled, Then the system rejects the attempt and leaves the status of the order unchanged.
Given an order whose status is closed, When the order staff attempts to mark it as filled, Then the system leaves the status of the order at closed.
Marking an order as filled changes its status only from pending to filled.
The status of an order is one of submitted, pending, filled, shipped or closed.

requirements.statement: As an OrderStaff, I want to decline a pending order, so that an order the business cannot fulfil is ended.

acceptance_criteria.text: Given an order whose status is pending, When the order staff declines it, Then the system sets the status of the order to closed.
Given an order whose status is not pending, When the order staff attempts to decline it, Then the system rejects the attempt and leaves the status of the order unchanged.
Given an order that the order staff has declined, When an invoice is requested for that order, Then the system rejects the request and records no invoice.
Given an order whose status is closed, When the order staff attempts to decline it, Then the system leaves the status of the order at closed.
Declining an order changes its status only from pending to closed.
The status of an order is one of submitted, pending, filled, shipped or closed.

requirements.statement: As an OrderStaff, I want to set a filled order to shipped, so that the dispatch of the customer's goods is on record.

acceptance_criteria.text: Given an order whose status is filled, When the order staff sets it to shipped, Then the system sets the status of the order to shipped.
Given an order whose status is not filled, When the order staff attempts to set it to shipped, Then the system rejects the attempt and leaves the status of the order unchanged.

Given a filled order that has an invoice with payments against it, When the order staff sets the order to shipped, Then the system leaves the status of the invoice and of every payment against it unchanged.
Given a filled order that has no invoice, When the order staff sets it to shipped, Then the system sets the status of the order to shipped without requiring an invoice to have been raised.
Setting a filled order to shipped and raising its invoice may occur in either order or at the same time.
Given an order whose status is closed, When the order staff attempts to set it to shipped, Then the system leaves the status of the order at closed.
Setting an order to shipped changes its status only from filled to shipped.
The status of an order is one of submitted, pending, filled, shipped or closed.

requirements.statement: As an Accountant, I want to confirm a pending payment, so that money actually received is recorded as settling the invoice.

acceptance_criteria.text: Given a payment whose status is pending, When the accountant confirms it, Then the system sets the status of the payment to completed.
Given a pending payment against an invoice whose status is issued, When the accountant confirms the payment, Then the system sets the status of that invoice to paid.
Given a pending payment against an invoice, When the accountant confirms the payment, Then the system leaves the status of the order billed by that invoice unchanged.
Given a payment whose status is not pending, When the accountant attempts to confirm it, Then the system rejects the attempt and leaves the status of the payment unchanged.
Confirming a payment changes its status only from pending to completed.
Confirming a payment changes the status of its invoice only from issued to paid.
The status of a payment is one of pending, completed or failed.
The status of an invoice is one of issued or paid.

requirements.statement: As an Accountant, I want to reject a pending payment, so that a payment that was not received does not count towards settling the invoice.

acceptance_criteria.text: Given a payment whose status is pending, When the accountant rejects it, Then the system sets the status of the payment to failed.
Given a pending payment against an invoice, When the accountant rejects the payment, Then the system leaves the status of that invoice and of the order billed by it unchanged.
Given a payment whose status is not pending, When the accountant attempts to reject it, Then the system rejects the attempt and leaves the status of the payment unchanged.
Rejecting a payment changes its status only from pending to failed.
The status of a payment is one of pending, completed or failed.

requirements.statement: As an OrderStaff, I want to close a shipped order whose invoice has been paid, so that a completed order is finished and protected from further change.

acceptance_criteria.text: Given an order whose status is shipped and whose invoice has the status paid, When the order staff closes it, Then the system sets the status of the order to closed.

Given an order whose status is shipped and that has no invoice or an invoice whose status is not paid, When the order staff attempts to close it, Then the system rejects the attempt and leaves the status of the order unchanged.

Given an order whose invoice has the status paid and whose status is not shipped, When the order staff attempts to close it, Then the system rejects the attempt and leaves the status of the order unchanged.
Given a filled order, When its shipping and the settlement of its invoice complete in either order, Then the system allows the order to be closed only after the later of the two has completed.
The status of an order whose status is closed is never changed.
Closing an order changes its status only from shipped to closed.
The status of an order is one of submitted, pending, filled, shipped or closed.

requirements.statement: The system shall register a submitted order containing up to 50 order items and respond within 2 seconds for at least 95% of such submissions under normal operating conditions.
The system shall support at least 200 concurrent users and at least 20 order submissions per second under normal operating conditions while meeting the response time of NFR-01.
The system shall authenticate every user before granting access to any customer, order, invoice or payment data, and shall reject 100% of unauthenticated requests.
The system shall allow only users holding the Accountant role to confirm or reject a payment, and shall reject 100% of such requests from users who do not hold that role.
The system shall encrypt customer personal data and bank account numbers in transit using TLS 1.2 or higher and at rest, so that none of this data is transmitted or stored in plaintext.
The system shall record the user and the time of every status change of an order, an invoice and a payment, and shall retain each such record for at least 12 months.
The system shall be available for at least 99.5% of each calendar month, excluding scheduled maintenance announced at least 24 hours in advance.
The system shall resume accepting requests within 15 minutes of a server failure without losing any order, invoice or payment recorded before the failure.
